instruction: Cinematic still with a retro 1980s aesthetic, medium shot at eye-level in an indoor dance studio with large arched windows. On the left, the man with a mustache and red headband in a blue t-shirt (R2) stands facing left, looking back over his shoulder with a smile while holding his arms in an aerobic pose. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair in a light blue leotard (R1) stands facing right, looking back over her shoulder with a smile. The man (R2) and the woman (R1) are positioned back-to-back, performing a synchronized aerobics routine. Bright, soft natural light streams from the windows behind them, creating a cool, airy palette.
